_about: Sera's companions as fighters (scripts/companions.gd, scripts/companion_magic.gd). character: what a companion has on top of their own HP and attack (which come from who they are): base and perLevel stats, as in combat.json's character; xpPerLevel matches the villagers' 30 a level. trees: a unique's own talent tree (its file), for those who have one; the rest learn on Sera's. books: a spell book a companion can be given in a talk (offer: the reply's words; item: the book, taken from Sera's bag; for: the unique it's for; talent: the talent in their own tree it gives them at once (rank 1, free), opening the rest of that tree to their points; records: chronicle events written; says: their line when there's no scene for it). magic: how a companion's spells go (what they cast and when is their tactics', data/tactics.json): think (unused now: tactics.json's think), pauseShare (share of a spell's cast time they stand casting, between pauseMin and pauseMax seconds), gap (seconds between two casts when their tactics don't say), healBelow and guardAfter (unused now: their tactics' rules decide), spells: each spell's use (attack, heal or guard; priority: the higher tried first among a kind; aim group: an area spell, at the spot with the most monsters, atLeast that many in its area; keepUp: unused now); a spell not listed that does damage is used to attack.

books.offer: Give her the Water Spell Book
books.says: It's really it! The water book! Look, it's already making sense... Sera, I can feel it. I can do this!
